body.statement: Among all \(64\) topologically labelled three-vertex acyclic mixed graphs, exactly eight have \(ID_G=1\), twenty-one have \(ID_G=2\), two have \(ID_G=3\), and thirty-three have positive-dimensional generic fibers. Consequently \(D_2(1)=1\), \(D_2(2)=2\), \(D_2(3)=3\), and \(D_2(n)\ge3\) for every \(n\ge3\) by isolated-vertex padding.
body.justification: The exact base case validates the source degree convention and exposes error variances as load-bearing coordinates.
body.gap: Published small-graph censuses classify rational or generic identification, not the minimum recursive certificate degree over structural and disturbance coordinates.
body.consumer: The frontier recurrence and every implementation receive exact base cases and analytic regression tests.
